newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit to issue 300 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit to issue 300 mln new shrs.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to issue 300 million new shares to its chairman Wong Shi Ling at HK$1.95 per share, raising net proceeds of HK$570 million.
Wong, the controlling shareholder of Leading Spirit, had in turn agreed to place the same number of existing shares at HK$1.95 per share to private investors, the company said in a statement.
CEF Capital Ltd is the sole placing agent for Wong.

The placing and issue price represented a discount of about 6.02 percent to the shares' last close of HK$2.075 per share on Monday before trading was suspended on Tuesday pending an announcement, it said.
Leading Spirit said it expected trading in its shares would resume on Wednesday.

Wong's holding in the components trader and maker for consumer electronic and electrical products would be diluted to about 59.08 percent of its enlarged issued capital from 66.42 percent after the deals, it added.

The company plans to use HK$200 million of the proceeds to reduce bank borrowings, HK$100 million for developing trading and assembly of computers and metal trading, and the balance for general corporate purposes and as additional working capital.
